title: Prove the exact paired-color batch frontier and sharp 10/9 penalty
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with finite corroboration: for two targets of each of m colors and capacity-three batches of a common fixed width, the exact batch/color-incidence frontier is

```text
ceil(2m/3) <= B <= m
I_min(B) = 2m-B
bill = A*B + C*I
```

This gives the optimal grouping for every positive setup price A and color price C. At the declared exchange-only counts A=6 and C=12, minimizing batch count can cost a sharp factor 10/9 more: the smallest sharp example costs 60 instead of the optimum 54. The better grouping removes 10% of that exchange sub-bill. No new kappa or physical construction is claimed.

This is a new optimization step motivated by unpaidmoon's PR #5538, first Open next question. Its occupied-color tariff is cited, not audited or replayed. Credit Cinna Davis #4100 for the CRT construction/exchange counts, Hiroki KUMAZAKI #4174 for the layout, and Ryanson Jonathan #4329 for the guard/placement context. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Apache-2.0.

Only research/paired-color-batch-frontier is added. PROOF.md gives the quantified lower bound and attaining family; verify.py supplies an independent complete small set-partition enumeration. Exact main-source provenance and the changed scope from the revision-8 uniform-transfer-audit card are recorded in SOURCES.json and TASK.json.

## Evidence

- Before: #5538 prices occupied colors but does not optimize joint batch/color statistics. Optimizing minimum batch count alone leaves the exchange tradeoff unresolved.
- After: I=2m-u and u<=B give the exact lower bound; an explicit assignment attains every frontier point. The m=3 witness separates minimum batching (B=2,I=4,E=60) from minimum bill (B=3,I=3,E=54). Equality in the 10/9 bound holds exactly when 3 divides m.
- Local warning-strict normal and optimized replays pass 64,098 capacity-three set partitions (m=1..5), 11,136 attaining groupings (m=1..256), 245 exact rational price cases against the complete enumerated optima, fourteen malformed-input controls, and all ratio equality tests through m=256.
- Every exact registered command was timed locally: 0.730 and 0.752 seconds, below its 120-second limit. The registered package runner passes. Six-file committed-byte, executable-mode and source-history preflight passes at 2235b3c6008da352f0a8c0f778d26d27dc2455f8.
- Official committed export and declared-input integrity checks pass. An optimized warning-strict replay from a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH passes, preserving all seven exported files' bytes and modes. Generated evidence receipts bind all six package-file hashes; no receipt is handwritten or used as a proof input.

From the repository root, using CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/paired-color-batch-frontier/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/paired-color-batch-frontier/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-color-batch-frontier
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/paired-color-batch-frontier --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected outputs: PASS_PAIRED_COLOR_BATCH_FRONTIER, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE, and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Another CPython 3.12 executable can replace the absolute interpreter path.

## Limitations

The result assumes unrestricted grouping, exactly two targets per color, capacity three and the same reservoir width in every batch. Only the six batch-placement and twelve per-color shuttle exchanges enter the 6B+12I example. No production layout is regrouped. Current target multiplicities, legal movement, stable position-mod-K colors, tree/control-reservoir constraints, additions, preparation, restoration and repair must all be established before a physical saving follows.

The unbounded result is a written mathematical proof; the finite enumeration corroborates it. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No native/full supplier replay, Lean, Docker or complete multiplication theorem check was run. The selected frontier and all five framework assumptions remain unchanged. No literature-priority claim for general colored packing is made.

## Open next questions

- Identify one source-bound CRT region permitting fixed-width regrouping with stable colors; then price its complete movement, additions, restoration and repair. No such caller is supplied here.
- Determine the exact frontier for other capacities or unequal multiplicities, starting with capacity four and explicit multiplicity vectors. Physical application still needs the preceding source-bound region.

## Related open work

- #4192 studies the uniform Beneš control compiler and its sequential arena cost. This grouping theorem does not alter or certify that preparation tariff.
- #4187 studies the elementary last-K CRT branch and its streamed payload tariff. The fixed-width occupied-color grouping problem here does not modify or replay that branch.

- #5909 studies a unit-fee target-rank partition threshold. This package keeps targets fixed and optimizes batch count and occupied-color incidence; the quantities differ, and no common numerical optimum is compared.

This account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM at 2026-10-27T12:36:42Z were refreshed before DONE. The eight other contributions inspected were #5909, #5910 and #5912 through #5917. None computes this paired-color batch frontier, and no same-quantity numerical disagreement was found. No additional computations were run to validate those contributions.

The open-PR, Discussion and local reservation checks found no open PR computing this same paired-color frontier. Canonical main remained de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a, priority revision 8, at the submission checkpoint. Cached note coverage is sparse; main README searches and live open/merged searches supplemented it, and unpublished work remains outside coverage.

All ten failure/error headers and the final summary match [PR #5909's plan log](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40505454496/job/122193490914) exactly. This confirms the shared onboarding blocker on main `de5ec2e7a`; maintainers will address it. No onboarding tests, shared files or package files were changed for this CI closeout.

The [package replay was skipped](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40506110737/job/122197332856). **Hosted replay has not certified this package; only local scientific and publication checks have run.** The local normal/optimized checks, registered commands, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history checks, official export integrity and read-only Git-free replay pass. This is not a green hosted workflow or mathematical acceptance.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: the new isolated research package. Shared code, predecessor files and the selected result are unchanged.
